<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Side-cart conflict test fixture
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
add_filter( 'wp_die_handler', static function () {
    return static function ( $message ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( wp_strip_all_tags( (string) $message ) );
    };
} );
$blocked = false;
try {
    $result = activate_plugin( 'starfiniti-cart/starfiniti-cart.php' );
    if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
        throw new RuntimeException( $result->get_error_message() );
    }
} catch ( RuntimeException $error ) {
    $blocked = str_contains( $error->getMessage(), 'FunnelKit Cart' );
}
if ( ! $blocked || ! is_plugin_active( 'cart-for-woocommerce/plugin.php' ) || is_plugin_active( 'starfiniti-cart/starfiniti-cart.php' ) ) {
    throw new RuntimeException( 'The side-cart activation conflict guard failed.' );
}
